name: BTC-Direction-V2
purpose: Bounded exploratory optimization; no claim of guaranteed 90 percent accuracy
refit_frequency: annual; first day of each UTC calendar year
selection_order: development mean annual direction accuracy descending
development worst annual direction accuracy descending
secondary_reused_comparisons: preselect one winner per family plus original V1, prior, and always-up; never replace development winner using reused-history results
stop_rule: Run the 40 fixed candidates once, select before reused-history evaluation, then report whether 90 percent is achieved; do not expand search using test outcomes
limitations: The entire history was previously inspected in V1; this is not a pristine test set.
Development winner statistics are selection-biased; no claim of global optimality.
Each prediction uses only completed daily OHLCV features.
Each refit excludes labels whose end timestamp reaches the refit date.
Scaling is fitted separately on each training subset; no global scaling.
No abstention in primary accuracy; all common eligible dates are included.
Exact zero forward returns belong to the not-up class.
Overlapping 30-day labels are dependent; use block bootstrap and disclose fixed-offset nonoverlapping checks.
A forecast probability of 90 percent is not observed accuracy of 90 percent.
Directional prediction scores do not imply after-cost profitable trading; no V2 PnL claim.
No new data, dependencies, plugins, paid services, or trading execution.
